FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Creative Spaces Interior Design specializes in providing personalized residential interior design services that focus on non-structural design consultation and project management. Our operations include creating customized design solutions tailored to our clients' individual preferences and needs, utilizing industry-standard design software for layout planning and visualization. We maintain strong relationships with reputable vendors and suppliers to source high-quality furnishings and decor materials. In every project, we adhere to best practices by keeping detailed contracts, client approvals, and comprehensive project documentation, ensuring clarity and accountability throughout the design process. Our team is committed to client confidentiality and data privacy, reflecting our dedication to protecting sensitive information. We operate exclusively in residential spaces, engaging in activities that do not include general construction, hazardous materials handling, or services for industrial properties.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday: Closed

FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Standard security measures including fencing around the premise and hiring watchpersons during non-business hours.
